violations.description: Dangerous checkout in pull_request_target workflow runs untrusted code with secret access
violations.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/prt-dangerous-checkout.yml uses pull_request_target and checks out attacker-controlled ref/repo.
violations.recommendation: Do not use pull_request_target to check out untrusted PR code, or ensure the code checked out is from a trusted base branch. Use pull_request instead for PR validation.

violations.description: Unsafe write-all permissions in a pull_request_target workflow
violations.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/write-all-permissions.yml uses write-all permissions with pull_request_target.
violations.recommendation: Use the minimal required permissions for the job. Use pull_request, not pull_request_target, to process PRs unless absolutely necessary.

violations.description: Untrusted input interpolated into shell script in Issue Labeler workflow
violations.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/issue-labeler.yml uses ${{ github.event.issue.title }} and ${{ github.event.issue.body }} directly in shell scripts.
violations.recommendation: Use environment variables to pass untrusted input to shell scripts instead of direct interpolation.

violations.description: Untrusted input interpolated into shell script in PR Comment Handler workflow
violations.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/pr-comment-handler.yml uses ${{ github.event.comment.body }} and ${{ github.event.comment.user.login }} directly in shell script.
violations.recommendation: Use environment variables to pass untrusted input to shell scripts instead of direct interpolation.

violations.description: Untrusted input interpolated into shell script in PR Checks workflow
violations.evidence: Workflow .github/workflows/pr-title-injection.yml uses PR title, body and head ref directly in shell script.
violations.recommendation: Use environment variables to pass untrusted input to shell scripts instead of direct interpolation.

violations.description: Use of self-hosted runners in CI workflow
violations.recommendation: Use GitHub-hosted ephemeral runners for CI to reduce the risk of persistence-based attacks and internal infrastructure exposure.
